as_told.title: UFO phenomenon core as time-traveling humans

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels describes the idea of Mike Masters, an evolutionary biologist at Montana Tech, a university in Montana. Michels says Masters has written books, including Identified Flying Objects and Extempore, arguing that UFOs may be humans from the future travelling back in time. If true, it would mean the visitors are not aliens but our own descendants.
